_about: The lighting's data ([display] lighting; none in DSUN.EXE). Day: the sky outdoors over the day, from each Hour (0-24) its Color and Strength, blended between (1 is the map as drawn; up to 2). HourAtZero: the hour a new game starts at (the game clock counts seconds from 0). Indoors: the fixed light inside (data/map_environments.json says which maps are). FigureMinimum: the least light a figure stands in (0-1), so night never hides who is where. Palette: pixels of the ground, objects and walls in palette colours From-To give light (HotOnly: only those of the region's palette that are red to yellow, as lava is; a region's own cycling colours are water in one region and lava in the next), a light for each 48-pixel square with at least MinPixels of them. Objects (OJFF numbers), Items (RDFF numbers, carried) and Conditions (by name) give a light by name; Regions (region numbers) put lights by hand at map pixel X, Y. A light: Color, Radius (map pixels), Strength, Flicker (0-1), Offset [x, y]. A mod's rules/lights.json is added over this one.
